completeness: exact signed ServiceOutcome serviceIds, including services never materialized; templates specify first physical day
close: day boundary passed and every expected original service outcome present; no inferred cancellation
identity: native template trainRunId plus :day-N for N>0; serviceRunId uses original serviceId and Gregorian serviceDay
costBasis: formation-operating-cost, exact physical distance of each actual vehicle times pinned M5 cents-per-train-km
rounding: sum millimetre-cent numerators before integer division by 1000000
posting: evidence only; never add again to report costs already charged as M6 mandatory vehicle cost
authority: signed initial policy is not a later OperatingTransition; changed contract bindings require separate verified source
legacy: absent optional fields retain original bytes and hashes
